limitations.finding: Human contract review confirms that a precise evidence-boundary abstention does not hallucinate when it merely references the user-requested subject. Judge v1.3 showed false-positive or unstable labels on this pattern.
limitations.decision: Do not change production to satisfy the Judge. Do not promote Judge v1.3.1 because it introduced dangerous false passes. Production retains the generic safe fallback.
limitations.reporting_policy: Report raw Judge v1.3 outputs unchanged and list this limitation separately; do not silently adjust scores or remove cases.
